visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young men are seated on a wooden pavilion structure. Two wear khaki-colored uniforms with glasses, while the central one wears a grey t-shirt and shorts. A person off-camera holds a microphone with a yellow 'HahaTai' logo. Red-leafed plants and a brick building are visible in the background under natural daylight. (2) The camera zooms in on the student on the left as he speaks with animated hand gestures, his fingers spread and moving near his chest. He wears rectangular glasses and looks downward slightly. (3) The scene cuts to a medium shot of another man in a khaki shirt holding a microphone and laughing. (4) Back to the first student, he performs a dramatic gesture with his hand over his forehead as if in despair. (5) The central student in the grey shirt takes the microphone, gesturing with his hands and smiling confidently while looking at his classmate. (6) The student in the khaki uniform points at his classmate in mock outrage, his mouth open as if shouting. (7) The central student stands up, raises his hands, and yells while flexing his muscles, his face contorted with effort. (8) The camera pans out to show all three men clapping and laughing together on the pavilion steps as a text overlay appears on the screen.
